meta.name: short-drama-storyboard
meta.description: 把中文短剧剧本和视觉设定写成有戏剧职责、连续性边界与冻结关键帧提示词的分镜 Markdown。用户提出“拆分镜/设计镜头/做镜头表”“场次视觉计划/调度故事板”“比较导演方案”“写首帧/关键帧提示词”或检查轴线、站位、视线、持物连续性时使用；不生成媒体。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解中文短剧剧本,输出带镜头职责、连续性约束与关键帧提示词的分镜表
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把短剧剧本落成可执行的分镜与镜头表,还在为轴线、站位和持物连续性发愁。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a short-drama script into a storyboard with continuity and keyframe cues.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you storyboard short dramas and keep tripping over axis, blocking, and prop continuity.

howto.what: 它把中文短剧剧本和视觉设定整理成《分镜.md》：每镜标出职责、来源、时长、起止状态和连续性，并写出冻结关键帧（可选收尾帧）的提示词正文，再按成稿画面核对视觉依据。它不生成图片或视频。
howto.when: 当你说「拆分镜/设计镜头/做镜头表」「写首帧/关键帧提示词」，或要检查轴线、持物等连续性时接管。它开始前会先读《剧本.md》的当前内容。

say.text: 帮我把这场戏拆成镜头，写清每镜职责和起止状态
say.note: 每镜唯一职责、来源、时长与起终点

say.text: 比较这场戏的两个导演方案，再定关键帧
say.note: 只在该场次确有多套成立方案时做

howto.what_en: Turns a Chinese short-drama script and visual facts into 剧集/<EP>/分镜.md: each shot gets one duty, source, duration, start/end states, continuity, and a frozen keyframe prompt. It writes markdown only and generates no media.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to split a script into shots, make a shot list, write first/keyframe prompts, or check axis, gaze and prop continuity. It reads the current 剧本.md first.

say_en.text: Use $short-drama-storyboard to finish EP001's storyboard and frozen keyframes.
say_en.note: Produces the storyboard from script and visual facts.

say_en.text: Split this scene into shots and give each one its duty and start/end states.
say_en.note: One duty, source, duration and boundaries per shot.

say_en.text: Compare the two directing options for this scene, then set the keyframe.
say_en.note: Only when the scene has several valid options.
